title: The canonical quotient sequence compared with the decalage tower
statement: For every abelian category C, the fixed canonical quotient sequence of every filtered cochain complex [lem-sp-filtered-complex-canonical-model] is isomorphic to the E2 sequence of its concrete decalage-tower spectral object [def-sp-filtered-complex-decalage-tower]. These isomorphisms are normalized so that for every filtered map the canonical page-two map, conjugated by the page-two interval comparison, is exactly the induced spectral-object interval cohomology map [lem-sp-spectral-object-page-two-functor]. No boundedness or CE hypothesis is required.

proof.text: Construct the individual normalized page isomorphisms and use their differential compatibility to obtain an isomorphism of page complexes. Their successor compatibility gives a morphism of spectral sequences; componentwise inverse chain maps give its inverse, with the commutativity equation obtained by cancellation.

lean.statement:
theorem filteredComplex_decalage_comparison
    (C : Type u) [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C] :
    ∃ e : ∀ U : FilteredObject (CochainComplex C ℤ),
      (filteredComplexCanonicalModel C).S.obj U ≅
        ((filteredComplexDecalageSpectralObjectFunctor C).obj U).E₂SpectralSequence,
      ∀ {U V : FilteredObject (CochainComplex C ℤ)} (t : U ⟶ V) (p q : ℤ),
        (((filteredComplexCanonicalModel C).S.map t).hom 2).f (p, q) ≫
            (Abelian.SpectralObject.pageTwoComparison
              ((filteredComplexDecalageSpectralObjectFunctor C).obj V)
              (e V) p q (p + q) rfl).hom =
          (Abelian.SpectralObject.pageTwoComparison
            ((filteredComplexDecalageSpectralObjectFunctor C).obj U)
            (e U) p q (p + q) rfl).hom ≫
            (((filteredComplexDecalageSpectralObjectFunctor C).map t).hom (p + q)).app
              (ComposableArrows.mk₁
                (homOfLE (by simp : (q : EInt) ≤ ((q + 1 : ℤ) : EInt))))
